morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic production slows with 15% unit shutdowns amid inventory overhang.
what_changed: Production slowed and 15 percent of Morbi ceramic units shut down due to high unsold inventory [64076d83f199].
Ceramic industry announced a tile price hike [835138f2fadb].
Proposed ceramic laboratory relocation to Jaipur underway due to building possession delays in Bikaner [a58d75b862c5].
stress_signals: Warehouses running full of unsold stock leading to 15 percent unit closures [64076d83f199].
Failure to mitigate or control rising propane gas prices compounding operational challenges [64076d83f199].
improvement_signals: Industry announced a tile price hike to counter margin pressures [835138f2fadb].
what_to_watch: Monitor inventory turnover and secondary sales velocity across closed and operating units.
Track propane gas price trends and their impact on operational viability.
Observe account-level working capital utilization and debt servicing delays for ceramic manufacturers.

surat.headline: Surat textiles face severe labor unrest and operational cuts, while diamonds show mixed demand signals
what_changed: Weaving units have initiated two-day weekly shutdowns due to high yarn prices, weak fabric demand, and strict 15-day payment terms.
Textile labor friction has escalated with the 'Gaon Chalo' protest movement and an early Diwali exodus, causing early seasonal production slowdowns.
The diamond sector presents a mixed outlook, shortening Diwali vacations due to improved demand despite recent massive layoffs of 20,000 workers.
stress_signals: Weavers cutting operations to five days a week due to high yarn prices, weak sales realization, and mandatory 15-day yarn payment rules [161041af6dcb, 0c72a246c955, d81a5c760dad, 57e5e152a5cb].
Textile trade dropped 50% driven by a doubling of coal prices, severely impacting energy-intensive processing and dyeing units [16a5b570eb9e].

Widespread labor unrest and operational friction, including 'Gaon Chalo' protests, demands for 8-hour workdays, and unresolved embroidery wage disputes [ce4764831b1f, 81627c3e849c, 73dfcce5d3f4, 1e9ddd9216ac].
Export decline in the diamond market resulting in 20,000 job losses [77d880834cf5] and a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud targeting local traders [cf2229091691].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond industry is shortening its traditional Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
International Colorstone Association GemLab (ICA-GemLab) is opening its first Indian testing laboratory in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].

Technological and testing advancements, with MANTRA positioning Surat as a global textile testing hub and successful testing of Surat-made fabric-coated surveillance balloons [0b9a805766c6, 5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Liquidity and cash flow health of weaving MSMEs under the strict 15-day yarn payment mandate ahead of Diwali.
The impact of the early worker exodus and 'Gaon Chalo' protests on festive-season production volumes.
Adherence of textile traders to FOSTTA's advisory on verifying new agents to mitigate credit and fraud risks.
